units: <cite ref="Shevuot 41b:6">Shebu. 41ᵇ</cite> <he>בשעת ת׳</he> at the time when the creditor asks for payment.
<cite ref="Ketubot 57b:9">Keth. 57ᵇ</cite> <he>משעת ת׳</he> from the time he summons her, or she summons him to make ready for the wedding.
<cite ref="Tosefta Ketubot 5:1">Tosef. ib. V, 1</cite>, v. <cite ref="B00089"><he>בַּגָּר</he></cite>; Y. ib. V, 29ᵈ <he>בשעה</he> (read: <he>בת׳</he>, or <he>בשעת ת׳</he>).
